name: Quick Product Importer
author: jaicreator

sections.description:
Quick Product Importer automatically extracts product information from any e-commerce website and creates WordPress posts with images, descriptions, and buy buttons. No API required!

Free Version Features

  • ✅ Single Product Import
  • ✅ Automatic Image Download (up to 4 images)
  • ✅ Auto-Publish Posts
  • ✅ SEO-Friendly Content
  • ✅ Custom Buy Now Button
  • ✅ Support for Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho & more

PRO Version Features

Upgrade to unlock these powerful features:

  • ⭐ Bulk Import – Import multiple products at once
  • ⭐ Custom Image Limits – Import unlimited images
  • ⭐ Button Color Customization – Match your brand
  • ⭐ Real-time Progress Tracking – Monitor bulk imports
  • ⭐ Automatic Retry – On failed imports
  • ⭐ Priority Support – Get help faster
  • ⭐ Lifetime Updates – Always stay current

Get Pro Version
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/quick-product-importer/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Quick Importer in the admin menu
  4. Start importing products!
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No! This plugin works without any API. Just paste the product URL.

How many products can I import?

You can import unlimited products one at a time. For bulk import, upgrade to Pro.
